jobs.occupation: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: IntroductionDo you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? In addition, you can work from home one day a week. If you choose Fuerteventura, we’ll also cover your flight, accommodations, and rental car.• Freedom & Responsibility: With us, you’ll take on responsibility, actively contribute your ideas, and work in an environment with short decision-making paths and no rigid processes.• Modern Office: Look forward to an ergonomic workspace in Munich with a height-adjustable desk, plenty of greenery from plants, an open atmosphere, and short decision-making paths.• Attractive Benefits: Monthly deposits to your EmployeeCARD, subsidies for cell phone and internet service, bike leasing, car subscription, retirement savings, and more.Please note: The application process is coordinated centrally by the ValueNet Group.Embracing Diversity TogetherAt ValueNet, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunity. Diversity enriches our team and creates space for innovation and shared success.Values that bring us togetherFor ValueNet, sustainability is more than just a word—it is an integral part of our actions, our products, and our services. Enthusiasm, trust, courage, and responsibility shape our culture. jobs.occupation: E-Learning Operations Officer (m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description: Your responsibilitiesYour Input The E-Learning Operations Officer supports the delivery of EIT Health's digital learning portfolio by contributing to project delivery, building and maintaining Moodle courses, conducting quality assurance, and providing learner support. The role works closely with Programme and Project Managers, SMEs, consortium partners, and the Digital Learning Team to ensure a high-quality learner experience and reports to the Learning Quality & Accreditation Manager.Learning Operations• Support the day-to-day delivery of learning projects in line with the Digital Learning Team (DLT) guidelines and standards.• Provide guidance to Programme support learning delivery.Moodle Course Development• Build and configure Moodle courses using established DLT templates and standards.• Drive content assembly, screen development, and course updates based on approved course storyboards and materials.• Manage course assets, assessments, certificates, and learner pathways.Quality Assurance• Conduct course testing and pre-launch quality reviews against established DLT standards and guidelines.• Review learner-facing content, communications, and activities against established instructional design, visual consistency, accessibility, and usability standards.• Review multimedia assets and coordinate issue resolution.Learner & LMS Support• Provide first-line Moodle administration and learner support.• Support learner enrolments, completion tracking, and certificate management.• Monitor and escalate platform issues as required.Continuous Improvement• Support the enhancement of Moodle templates, DLT processes, and learner experience.• Identify recurring operational issues and suggest opportunities for process improvement.Your skills & knowledge• Bachelor's degree in Education, Learning Technology, Instructional Design, operations, or a related area.• Hands-on experience with Moodle or a comparable Learning Management System (LMS), including content authoring, assessments, learner enrolment, completion tracking, and certificates, as well as proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.• Basic understanding of instructional design principles and online learning practices.• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail and quality.• Excellent communication skills in English.Desirable• Experience with Articulate Rise, Storyline, or similar authoring tools, as well as quality assurance, content review, and course testing.• Knowledge of accreditation requirements such as ECTS, EIT Label, UEMS/EACCME.• Experience working in an international education setting.What we offer• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany and Poland.• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.• Flexible working hours.• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior representatives from key players and influencers.• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Ihre AufgabeSie übernehmen die Gesamtverantwortung für eine der operativ bedeutendsten Funktionen an unserem Standort Schnelldorf — die Leitung der gesamten Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik. In dieser Funktion gestalten Sie aktiv, wie Waren effizient, regelkonform und zuverlässig entlang einer komplexen internationalen Lieferkette bewegt werden. Sie führen ein Team von rund 45 Mitarbeitenden und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für die Leistung der Logistikfunktion. Sie treiben die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Logistikprozesse voran — von Wareneingängen und Auslieferungen über die Gefahrgutabwicklung bis hin zur Zollabfertigung — und stellen dabei die vollständige Einhaltung aller relevanten Vorschriften sicher, einschließlich der Gefahrgutgesetzgebung und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit. Sie fördern Digitalisierungsinitiativen, die die Arbeitsweise der Funktion modernisieren und nutzen SAP-basierte Systeme in den Bereichen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport, um messbare Verbesserungen in Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz zu erzielen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle innerhalb des Standorts und darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie eng mit Supply Chain Management, Lagerlogistik, Customer Service, Ländergesellschaften, Speditionen, Trade Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality und Zoll zusammen. Ihre Fähigkeit, über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg zu führen und strategische Prioritäten in operative Exzellenz zu übersetzen, ist entscheidend für Ihren Erfolg in dieser Rolle.Wer Sie sind- Sie verfügen über mindestens 10 Jahre Führungserfahrung in vergleichbarem Umfang und können eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Leitung großer, funktionsübergreifender Logistikteams in einem internationalen Umfeld vorweisen- Sie haben einen Masterabschluss, bevorzugt in Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation, die durch umfangreiche Berufserfahrung gestützt wird- Sie bringen umfassende Expertise in der Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik, der Gefahrgutabwicklung sowie im Zollwesen mit, einschließlich tiefgehender Kenntnisse der relevanten Rechtsgrundlagen und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit- Sie verfügen über fundierte SAP-Kenntnisse in den Modulen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport sowie über ausgeprägte Erfahrung mit den zugehörigen Logistik-IT-Systemen und eine klare Affinität zur Digitalisierung- Sie haben ein solides Verständnis betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge, organisatorischer Prozesse und arbeitsrechtlicher Grundlagen, das es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihr Team sowohl operativ als auch in der Personalführung sicher zu leiten- Sie kommunizieren fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau und verfügen über nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Präsentation und Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Dienstleistern und Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichen Kulturkreisen- Sie bringen eine kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft mit, unterstützt durch Weiterbildungen in Personalführung und Kommunikation, und sind motiviert, die Menschen in Ihrem Umfeld weiterzuentwickelnWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027.Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!
